verdict.rationale: The evidence documents agent-facing commerce infrastructure: catalog search, cart, checkout and order MCP servers, a CLI, and webhooks. Nothing shows the product generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's own data inside the product. Adjacent items such as personalized search results with a buyer-linked token, or creating a store from a prompt, are different capabilities and earn no credit. A commerce platform could plausibly ship AI-driven insights, so the axis applies and absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
